rows.grounds: subject of the resulting attainments; can also imply conduct or means of living
predicate asserting the arising of the listed attainments
affirms the certainty of the result

items.question: Which enduring personal attainments are assured as fruits of the prescribed dawn recitation?
premises: The preceding verse states that one who recites at dawn obtains the desired fruit.
This verse enumerates specific attainments as that fruit.
The adverb dhruvam marks the result as certain.
items.inference: Therefore, fame, prosperity, radiance, intelligence, lifespan, and livelihood certainly arise for the dawn reciter.
uncertainties: vṛttiḥ may mean livelihood, conduct, or general well-being depending on context.
items.plain_english: Fame, prosperity, radiance, intelligence, long life, and livelihood certainly come to be.
